title: Debatable Intelligence: Benchmarking LLM Judges via Debate Speech Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the evaluation scores assigned by LLM judges to human-authored debate speeches versus speeches generated by state-of-the-art LLMs (e.g., GPT-4.1) to determine if models preferentially rate AI-generated text higher than human expert text.

Applying Key Point Analysis (KPA) to the chain-of-thought explanations of LLM judges to identify whether higher scores are disproportionately awarded based on surface-level structural and stylistic properties (e.g., division into clear paragraphs, structured openings) rather than underlying argument quality.
